title: Change of variables for H^n under a dilation
statement: Let N, n ∈ ℕ and H = H^n = μHE[n], a measure on ℝ^N = Euclidean N. Let s > 0, let D ⊆ ℝ^N be an arbitrary set and let f : ℝ^N → [0,∞] be an arbitrary function. Then ∫⁻_D f dH = s^n · ∫⁻_{w : s·w ∈ D} f(s·w) dH(w). The integrals are lower Lebesgue integrals, s^n means ENNReal.ofReal s ^ n, and neither D nor f is assumed measurable.
lean_statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (s : ℝ) (D : Set (Euclidean N)) (f : Euclidean N → ℝ≥0∞), 0 < s → ∫⁻ x in D, f x ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) = ENNReal.ofReal s ^ n * ∫⁻ w in {w : Euclidean N | s • w ∈ D}, f (s • w) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N))
